summary: Could not write any file. The packet orders edits at shared-checkout absolute paths, but the worktree isolation hook refuses those and redirects to worktree copies; the fable-opus scope guard then refuses the worktree copies because it resolves them to worktree-relative paths that do not match the contract's absolutes. No path is writable, so no edits were made and the worktree is clean. The packet's premise is also wrong: my worktree does contain all four pages, byte-identical to the shared checkout (verified by diff). Re-dispatch with worktree-relative paths in the file contract, or to a non-isolated worker. Exemplar and all four pages are read; rewrite is planned.
open_questions: Should the file contract be rewritten as worktree-relative paths (pages/markless/concepts/*.mdx) so the scope guard matches the isolated worktree, or should this unit be re-dispatched to a non-isolated opus-worker that can write the shared checkout directly?
